summary: Record a disposable-lab walkthrough installing Windows 11 IoT Enterprise LTSC under UEFI on a fresh Nex Core 0.2.7 host and Controller, with the issues found. API impact: none; exploratory QA report only.

guide.reason: No behavior changed. Guide gaps found for Windows boot prompt, VirtIO driver media and post-install eject are recorded as issues W2, W3 and W7 for the fixing change to address.

api.reason: API impact: none. The walkthrough used existing Controller session, media upload/download, VM create, power, media insert and console contracts without changing them.

roadmap.reason: Findings only; TPM, Secure Boot control and Windows-aware defaults are suggested fix directions pending project owner triage, not scope changes.

state.reason: Documentation only; no durable state added.

verification.method: Fresh ISO install of Nex Core 0.2.7 in a disposable nested-KVM lab, Controller deployed from the Core local UI, Windows ISO upload, VM creation and a complete Windows install driven through the Controller web console with Playwright; host-side virsh reads for evidence. python3 scripts/check_docs.py --worktree and the repository privacy test.
